# Ultracode
**Dynamic workflows for DeepSeek Harness.**
Ultracode is a session mode that turns every substantive task into a multi-agent workflow. Arm it on
ce; the agent scopes the work, writes a `workflow` script, fans out subagents in phases, verifies ad
versarially, and synthesizes the result.
## Screenshots
The overview block, a live run, and a finished run.
*The Ultracode tab in context.*
*The workflow tool's run card.*
## Features
- **Session mode, not a model setting.** `/ultracode [on|off|status]` arms one session. The stance i

s folded from the command log, so resume, fork, and replay restore it.
- **Workflow-first policy.**
While armed, a prompt section after the `workflow` tool's own guidance classifies work as substantiv
e or trivial, requires phases and `pipeline`/`parallel` fan-out, isolates writers, adds adversarial

verification, and asks for evidence in the report.
- **Composer switch.** A quiet bordered pill when
off; a flat accent tint and dot when armed, plus a thin seam along the composer edge. No gradients,

no icon glyphs.
- **Workflow sidebar.** The `ULTRA` badge opens a right-sidebar ledger: running and
finished runs, phase cards with progress rails and dots, per-agent status, model, tokens, and wall

time, verification tags, a high-fan-out marker, and child-transcript drill-down.
- **Answers from th
e log.** No new session-event types. One projection folds `/ultracode` command lifecycles; another f
olds `tool-workflow/*` records and closes runs abandoned by interrupted or forked turns. Phases keep

their raw identity; cancelled outcomes stay distinct from failures.
- **No build step, no dependenc
ies.** Plain ESM and browser JavaScript, host theme tokens, English and Chinese copy.
## Preset compatibility
Ultracode is a stance, not a preset. It needs the preset's `workflow` tool.
| Preset | `workflow` tool | Ultracode behavior |

| Standard | yes | Full policy, phases, subagents, verification, and ledger. |
| Creator (`cordis`)

| yes | Full; Standard's tools plus plugin-authoring tools. |
| PTC | no; only `run_code` and its SD
K | Policy suppressed. The overview reports **Workflow unavailable in this preset**; no workflow run
s. PTC can call subagents as SDK bindings, but that is code-level PTC, not a tracked Ultracode workf

low. |
| Minimal | no; persistent shell + `read_image` | UI-only. The complete persona also suppress

es the policy; the overview reports **Workflow unavailable in this preset**. |
| Custom | depends on
its composition | Full when it composes `workflow-ptc` and `tool-workflow`; otherwise the policy is
on | Full when it composes `workflow-ptc` and `tool-workflow`; otherwise the policy is suppressed. |
The policy checks whether `workflow` is model-visible for the agent. The overview warning recognizes
the built-in `minimal` and `ptc` presets; a custom preset without workflow gets the suppressed poli
cy but no preset-name warning.

0.2.1-rc.2**; nearby versions with the same services should work.

## Usage
| Action | How |

| Arm the session | `/ultracode`, or click the Ultracode pill in the composer |
| Disarm | `/ultraco

de off`, the composer pill, or the panel overview's arm control |
| Check the stance | `/ultracode s

tatus` |
| Open the ledger | Click the `ULTRA` badge in the session header, or right sidebar → **Ult

racode** |
| Inspect a run | Expand **Finished**, open a phase, click an agent to read its child tra

|
| Inspect a run | Expand **Finished**, open a phase, click an agent to read its child transcript |
Ultracode is per session. Trivial requests — a lookup, a one-line edit, a single command — stay dire
ct and say why. Substantive requests become workflows.
The panel is workflow-focused. Shell and other background jobs remain in DSH's existing jobs control
he panel is workflow-focused. Shell and other background jobs remain in DSH's existing jobs control.
### Troubleshooting
- **The `ULTRA` badge shows a red `!`** — hover it for the failure. The opener falls back to expandi

ng the right sidebar guide.
- **The Ultracode tab is missing or unavailable after an update** — hard
-refresh the page (`Ctrl+Shift+R`). Client plugins are loaded from the page's module graph at boot,

so a stale graph can survive a hot reload.
- **The badge does nothing at all** — check **Settings →
Plugins** for a page-local client sync error, then refresh and retry.
## How it works

- `ultracode` projection — `{ active, pending }` folded from `command/run` / `command/done`.
- `ultr
acodeRuns` projection — run, phase, member, status, and timing data folded from `tool-workflow/run-s

tart|agent-start|agent-end|run-end`, with `turn/end` handling for interrupted and forked turns.
- `u
ltracode:policy` — a prompt section at order `2650`, after the workflow tool's guidance at `2600`; e

mpty while disarmed.
- Client half — a composer pill, an `ULTRA` badge, an armed seam, and a right-s
idebar tab type. Agent model/token/time values join each member's `childId` to the sessions catalog.
More detail: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
